473ddab2: /**
 * This block of code is responsible for clearing the temporary global ^TMP("DGJRPT",$J)
 * and initializing variables to display a message when no deficiency was created for the patient.
 */
b13fdd39: Kill the temporary global that stores report data.
632d51ba: Initialize the VALMCNT and DGJCNT variables to 0.
91b9af7e: Set the VALMBG and X variables, where X will store the message to be displayed.
b9aef9eb: Set the X variable with the formatted message using the SETSTR^VALM1 function.
2425b06f: Call the TMP^DGJTVW2 routine to display the message stored in X.
0b1ee403: Exit the TMP routine.

2205d350: This code handles jumping to a specific category in the deficiency list. It first checks if the XQORNOD(0) array contains a value, and if so, it attempts to parse a category ID from that value. If a valid category ID is found, it calls the JUMP1 routine with that ID.
d45f2061: If no category ID was found in XQORNOD(0), this code prompts the user to select a category from the ^VAS(393.41, file using the ^DIC reader.
e41e40f4: If the user enters '^' (up-arrow), it sets the VALMBG and VALMBCK variables and exits the JUMP routine.
3c42f4bb: If the user did not select a valid category (Y<0), it branches back to the JUMP routine.
bab6efc9: Declare a local variable DGJXCAT to store the selected category ID.
cffd169e: Set the DGJXCAT variable to the selected category ID.
f92e0d09: If the selected category does not contain any deficiencies (DGJCAT(DGJXCAT) is undefined), it displays a message and branches back to the JMP routine.

0f98b718: If the selected category contains deficiencies, it sets the VALMBG variable to the value of DGJCAT(DGJXCAT) and sets the VALMBCK variable to 'R', which presumably indicates that the user has successfully navigated to the selected category.
45ffd56e: ;Allows user to jump to a specific category
